name: Baby Adopter Dress Up
summary:
Baby Adopter Dress Up is a babysitting and dress-up game where you take care of a child and watch him grow. 

Earn points by feeding and caring for your baby, going on egg hunts, and playing mini-games. Use those points to buy clothes, shoes, hats, toys, and decorations for different locations in the game.

Baby Viewer lets you see your baby in full 3D. You can orbit and rotate the character in all directions with the controller and play animations such as idle, look around, walk, run, dance and gym exercis
